title: Financial District & waterfront from Boston Harbor
note: Custom House Tower, One International Place, harbour wharves.

title: Eye level on Boston Common, looking to the State House
note: Street realism: path surface, benches, people, tree canopy overhead, the gold dome beyond.

title: Low oblique over the Back Bay grid
note: Rowhouse rhythm, brick and brownstone variation, Commonwealth Ave mall.

note: The inverted-Y towers and cable fan must be unmistakable.

title: Seaport / Fort Point at night
note: Window lights, street lamps, reflections on the channel, bloom discipline.

title: High aerial over the whole peninsula
note: Overall city read: land/water shape, density gradient, colour variety.

title: Fenway Park and the Emerald Necklace
note: The ballpark bowl, light towers, and surrounding park greenery.

title: State House golden dome over Beacon Hill
note: Gilded dome specular response, brick rowhouse texture, warm low sun.

title: Low over the Charles basin toward Back Bay
note: Water close-up: wave detail, reflections of the Back Bay skyline, shoreline foam.

title: Boston Harbor looking back at the Financial District
note: Open-water swell, turbid green-brown colour, wharves and the shoreline transition.

title: Commonwealth Avenue Mall at eye level
note: Street trees in rows, the mall, brownstone frontage, moving traffic and people.

title: Downtown intersection, pedestrian level
note: Vehicles, crossings, lane markings, kerbs and footfall in the Financial District.

title: Downtown at street level after dark
note: Street lamps, shopfronts, headlights and wet-looking tarmac. The only eye-level night test: every emissive in the city is authored display-referred and has to survive the exposure lift.

title: The Prudential Tower and its podium from the south-west
note: Landmark-vs-OSM overlap: the hand-authored tower has to sit in its podium, not through the buildings around it.

title: Boylston Street below the Prudential
note: Looking up the tower from the street; any footprint intersecting the mesh shows here first.
